source_citation: Layer thicknesses, pitches and SOA limits from data/reference-library/02_semiconductor_pdk_silicon.json (SKY130A pinned commits); cell functions/gate counts from 03_multiradix_logic_baselines.json (Phase 0 verified 4/4 Q4 primitives); CMOS transistor structure geometry from Weste & Harris 'CMOS VLSI Design' 4th ed. standard layouts and SKY130A hd cell published footprints (08_standard_and_multiradix_cells.json). Scene presentation scales are declared per-workspace; physical dimensions are true-to-scale in µm.

units.scene_note: 1 scene unit = 1 µm grid label; the 3D stack is vertically exaggerated ×3 for legibility (declared exaggeration factor, not a hidden scale lie)

layer_stack_3d.source: 02_semiconductor_pdk_silicon.json → parameters.sky130a.metal_stack.thickness_nm (met1 570 nm, met2 845 nm, met3 1035 nm; li1 250 nm)

verified_cells.provenance: Phase 0 verified 4/4 SKY130A Q4 primitives — DRC=0 (Magic), Netgen unique LVS ✓, RC PEX ✓, sky130 commit f62031a1be9aefe902d6d54cddd6f59b57627436

wafer.scene_scale: die region shown as 4.2 × 2.9 scene units on a 2.6-radius wafer disc

parametric_bindings.generator_contract: apps/electrophysics-3d renders layers from SKY130_LAYERS + this spec; layer visibility/opacity driven by the Silicon inspector panel; geometry is generated procedurally at runtime from these numbers — zero binary .glb assets
parametric_bindings.forbidden: no hand-tuned magic numbers in the renderer; every dimension traces to 02/08 JSON or this file
